story: Kamsa, king of Mathura, heard a voice at his sister Devaki's wedding foretell that her eighth son would kill him. He imprisoned Devaki and her husband Vasudeva and killed six of their children. The eighth, Krishna, was smuggled out and later killed him.
belief: He is the image of a tyrant ruled by fear. 'Kamsa mama' is still used for a cruel uncle.
turns: He imprisoned his own father, King Ugrasena, to take the throne. Every attempt to escape the prophecy, including sending demons to kill baby Krishna, only brought it closer.
facts: The seventh child, Balarama, was secretly moved to Rohini's womb.
He sent demons like Putana and Trinavarta after the infant Krishna.
Krishna restored Ugrasena to the throne after killing him.
